newsitem.title: USA: Anchor Glass proceeding with bankruptcy sale.
newsitem.headline: Anchor Glass proceeding with bankruptcy sale.

text.p: Anchor Glass Container Corp said Monday it is completing arrangements for the sale of substantially all of its business and assets to Consumers Packaging Inc and Owens-Brockway Glass Container Inc under an agreement approved December 20, 1996, by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court administering Anchor's Chapter 11 case.

Since the closing did not occur by January 31 each party now has the unilateral right to terminate the agreement. However, no such termination has occurred, said Anchor, and the asset sale is proceeding.
Anchor expects that upon closing, the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corp's prior notice regarding its intention to terminate Anchor's Defined Benefit Pension Plans would be withdrawn.
